verdicts.reason: Both are the same shrunk banner band floated in the upper-middle of a taller canvas. The bottom third is dead white space, the building photo is a thin cropped strip cut off at the left edge, and the headline now wraps with an orphaned 'us.' on its own line. B is only marginally better because its text block sits a little further from the right edge (A's 'not'/'for' nearly touch the canvas edge); otherwise they are equivalent.
